choice.question: Who are you?
choice.professionalBody: I follow people who measure themselves and I want the dashboard, the CRM and the reports.
choice.clientBody: I measure myself with the app, on my own or followed by a professional.
choice.clientHeading: You don't need an account on the website
choice.clientIntro: Stress Index for people who measure themselves lives in the app on your phone. There are two ways to start.
choice.clientOption1Body: They create your access from their area and you receive an email to choose a password. Your measurements are linked right away to whoever follows you.
choice.clientOption2Title: Or sign up from the app
choice.clientOption2Body: Download Stress Index and create your account directly in the app, as a client. You can link to a professional later on.
